title: Entities / Tools
catalogHint: Choose a source, then combine status, tags and keywords. Separate multiple keywords with spaces.
unclassified: {{count}} tools do not provide source metadata yet and remain searchable under All sources. Update and restart the backend to filter them by source.
groupToggleHint: The group switch affects every tool in this group, including tools hidden by the current filters.

core.label: Core tools
core.hint: Core tools belong to the framework. Code changes require a backend restart; entity synchronization does not reload the core.

entity.label: Entity extensions
entity.hint: Entity reload updates tool and router entry points. Changes to stateful services and helper modules still require a restart.

channel.label: Channel tools
channel.hint: Channel tools belong to adapters. Reload the channel from Channel Management; running connections will reconnect.

external.label: External integrations
external.hint: Remote MCP tools and other extensions are updated through their integration managers. Entity synchronization does not update remote services.

tagsHint: always = persistent | core = core tool | output = output tool | media:image = image processing
reloadHint: Reload updates backend tool and router entry points; stateful services need a restart. Frontend development uses hot updates; production changes need a rebuild and page refresh.
reloadBusy: Entity synchronization is in progress. Please try again shortly.
reloadFailed: Some entities failed to reload: {{names}}. Check the server logs.
subtitle: Find capabilities, manage availability and refine tool instructions.
